import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap, cost;
        Edge rev;

        Edge(int _src, int _dst, long _cap, long _cost, Edge _rev) {
            src = _src;
            dst = _dst;
            cap = _cap;
            cost = _cost;
            rev = _rev;
        }
    }

    static class FlowBase {
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        FlowBase(int _n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < _n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        FlowBase(FlowBase other) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < other.size(); i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            for (int node = 0; node < other.size(); node++) {
                for (Edge e : other.adj.get(node)) {
                    if (e.src == node) {
                        adj.get(e.src).add(new Edge(e.src, e.dst, e.cap, e.cost, null));
                        adj.get(e.dst).add(new Edge(e.dst, e.src, e.rev.cap, e.rev.cost, null));
                        adj.get(e.src).get(adj.get(e.src).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(e.dst).get(adj.get(e.dst).size() - 1);
                        adj.get(e.dst).get(adj.get(e.dst).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(e.src).get(adj.get(e.src).size() - 1);
                        e.rev.src = -1;
                    } else {
                        e.rev.rev.src = node;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int size() {
            return adj.size();
        }

        List<Edge> get(int node) {
            return adj.get(node);
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            adj.get(src).add(new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null));
            adj.get(dst).add(new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null));
            adj.get(src).get(adj.get(src).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(dst).get(adj.get(dst).size() - 1);
            adj.get(dst).get(adj.get(dst).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(src).get(adj.get(src).size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow extends FlowBase {
        long minCost, totalCost;
        long[] supp;
        long[] ptnl, dist;
        Edge[] last;

        MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            super(_n + 2);
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supp = new long[_n + 2];
            ptnl = new long[_n + 2];
            dist = new long[_n + 2];
            last = new Edge[_n + 2];
        }

        MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
            super(other);
            minCost = other.minCost;
            totalCost = other.totalCost;
            supp = other.supp.clone();
            ptnl = other.ptnl.clone();
            dist = other.dist.clone();
            last = other.last.clone();
        }

        int size() {
            return super.size() - 2;
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (src == dst) return;
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost;
                super.addEdge(dst, src, cap, -cost);
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                super.addEdge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, long vol) {
            supp[node] += vol;
        }

        boolean dijkstra(int src, int dst) {
            final long INFINITY = totalCost + 1;
            Arrays.fill(dist, INFINITY);
            dist[src] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> que = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> -a[0]));
            que.offer(new long[]{0, src});
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = que.poll();
                long ndist = -cur[0];
                int now = (int) cur[1];
                if (ndist != dist[now]) continue;
                ptnl[now] += ndist;
                dist[now] = -1;
                for (Edge e : adj.get(now)) {
                    if (dist[e.dst] == -1 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    if (dist[e.dst] + ptnl[e.dst] > ptnl[now] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.dst] = ptnl[now] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        last[e.dst] = e;
                        que.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[dst] != -1;
        }

        boolean solve() {
            int src = super.size() - 2;
            int dst = src + 1;
            long flow = 0;
            long suppSum = 0;
            for (int node = 0; node < super.size(); node++) {
                suppSum += supp[node];
                if (supp[node] > 0) {
                    flow += supp[node];
                    addEdge(src, node, supp[node], 0);
                } else if (supp[node] < 0) {
                    addEdge(node, dst, -supp[node], 0);
                }
                supp[node] = 0;
            }
            if (suppSum != 0) return false;
            while (flow > 0) {
                if (dijkstra(src, dst)) return false;
                long resid = flow;
                for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                    resid = Math.min(resid, last[node].cap);
                }
                flow -= resid;
                minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                    last[node].cap -= resid;
                    last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        long optimal() {
            solve();
            return minCost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int j = sc.nextInt();
            j--;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            u--;
            v--;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; ++t) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; ++x) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; ++t) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
